user.title: Connect to TMD NWP
user.description: Create an NWP personal token using Create New Token at the [TMD website]({token_url}). Provide separate observation uid/ukey credentials to use the nearest TMD station for current conditions. Leaving both optional fields blank uses explicitly modeled NWP current conditions. Hourly/daily forecasts always use NWP.

data_description.access_token: Enter only the token, without the Bearer prefix. If it expires, Home Assistant will ask you to reauthenticate.
data_description.latitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.observation_uid: Provide with ukey to use actual nearby TMD station observations.
data_description.observation_key: Separate from the NWP token. Leave both fields empty for modeled current conditions.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with TMD
reauth_confirm.description: TMD rejected a stored credential. Enter only the credentials that need replacement; blank fields retain their existing values. NWP personal tokens are issued through the TMD website and are separate from observation uid/ukey.

data_description.access_token: Enter a replacement NWP token without Bearer, or leave blank to retain the stored token.
data_description.observation_uid: Provide with ukey to use actual nearby TMD station observations.
data_description.observation_key: Separate from the NWP token. Leave both fields empty for modeled current conditions.

reconfigure.title: Configure station observations
reconfigure.description: Enable stations and supply the separate TMD uid/ukey pair, or turn off station observations to use explicitly modeled NWP current conditions.

data_description.observation_uid: Provide with ukey to use actual nearby TMD station observations.
data_description.observation_key: Separate from the NWP token. Leave both fields empty for modeled current conditions.
data_description.use_observations: Turn off to use modeled NWP current conditions while preserving the location and entities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TMD. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: TMD rejected authentication. Check the NWP token and any configured observation uid/ukey.
error.rate_limited: TMD's request limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
error.invalid_location: The coordinate/data request is invalid, or no nearby station has a fresh usable observation within 100 km.
error.invalid_response: TMD did not return usable, timezone-aware forecast data for this location and current hour. Try again later; if it persists, report the issue.
error.service_unavailable: The TMD service or endpoint is unavailable. Try again later.
error.unknown: An unexpected TMD API error occurred. Try again later.
error.observation_credentials_required: Enter both observation uid and ukey, or leave both empty.
error.request_timed_out: TMD did not respond in time. Domain 2 requests may take up to 60 seconds. Try again later.

invalid_auth.message: TMD rejected a configured credential. Reauthentication is required.

rate_limited.message: TMD's request limit was reached. Updates will resume after the retry deadline.

update_failed.message: Unable to update TMD forecast data. Home Assistant will retry automatically.

init.title: Configure weather fetching
init.description: Choose how often to fetch current weather and forecasts, in minutes. More frequent fetching does not make TMD publish new data sooner. API rate-limit backoff still applies.

data_description.fetch_interval: A whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes. Applies to current conditions, hourly forecasts and daily forecasts. Your location and entity IDs are preserved.
data_description.forecast_source: Domain 2 requests the model TMD describes as a 3 km grid, selecting the nearest grid point within 3 km of your coordinates. It changes modeled current conditions and hourly forecasts. Daily forecasts and real station readings keep their existing sources. The new source is checked before saving.

error.invalid_fetch_interval: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes.
error.invalid_auth: TMD rejected authentication. Check the NWP token and any configured observation uid/ukey.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TMD. Check your connection and try again.

error.invalid_location: The forecast request is invalid or this location is not supported. Domain 2 requires a returned grid point within 3 km. Try the existing forecast source.
error.invalid_response: The selected source did not return usable forecast data. Your previous settings were retained.
error.service_unavailable: The TMD service or endpoint is unavailable. Try again later.
